sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run of form. Sandbach are unbeaten in their last five matches (four wins and a draw) and sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games. Alsager Town arrive as one of the division's bottom sides with just 4 points, winless in their last five outings, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to maintain their advantage.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tough away test at Dawley Town in a fixture that could have title-race implications, with Stafford sitting just two points behind leaders Sandbach. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in what looks competitive, as both teams occupy the upper half of the table. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in a mid-table clash, while in-form Bilston Town (fifth, unbeaten in three) travel to Foley Meir. Brereton Social host Widnes Town, a mismatch on paper as Widnes are rooted at the bottom with just 2 points and on a four-game losing streak. Market Drayton Town face New Mills away; both occupy the lower-mid section and will be eyeing three points. Shawbury United (tenth, on a five-game losing streak) travel to Barnton (seventh), while struggling Crewe host Allscott Heath in another low-table battle. Cheadle Heath Nomads make the trip to Telford Town in what is a fixture between two of the division's poorest-performing sides. Finally, Sandbach's fellow high-flyers will be watching closely as the weekend's results unfold across all ten fixtures.
